articulation.label: cat
articulation.alt: cat: /k/ → /æ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: mat
articulation.alt: mat: /m/ → /æ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: sit
articulation.alt: sit: /s/ → /ɪ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: bag
articulation.alt: bag: /b/ → /æ/ → /ɡ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/ɡ/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; add voice.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
